description: This file provides documentation and virtual class definitions for CKEDITOR plugin definitions, including properties like 'requires', and functions like 'beforeInit' and 'init' for plugin lifecycle management.

classes.name: CKEDITOR.pluginDefinition
classes.description: A virtual class representing plugin definitions in CKEDITOR, mainly used for documentation and illustrative purposes, not instantiated directly.

methods.name: requires
methods.description: A list of plugins required by this plugin, not guaranteeing load order.

methods.name: beforeInit
methods.description: Function called before initialization of each editor instance; used for pre-initialization setup.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Function called during editor initialization for each editor instance.
